Swiss Army Bench 0.0.2: fixes from the first real install of the 0.0.1 beta.

- **`swissarmybench start` opens the app.** It opens the page in your browser and prints the page's full address,
  with its `#token=` part (the part after `#` never leaves your computer). 0.0.1 printed an address without it, so
  the page could not be reached. `--no-browser` keeps the browser closed.
- **`swissarmybench open`** opens the running app's page again. Starting it a second time also opens its page.
- **The Windows installer finishes in Windows PowerShell 5.1.** In 0.0.1 a harmless note from uv ("Executable
  directory ... is already in PATH") stopped the script after the server had installed. The release now tests the
  installer in Windows PowerShell 5.1.

## Install or update

Windows (PowerShell):

```powershell
irm https://github.com/DylanCodyBrown/SwissArmyBench/releases/download/v0.0.2/install.ps1 | iex
```

macOS or Linux:

```bash
curl -LsSf https://github.com/DylanCodyBrown/SwissArmyBench/releases/download/v0.0.2/install.sh | sh
```

Then `swissarmybench start`. Everything in 0.0.1's notes still applies.
